topic_title: Obtaining, Possessing & Renewing Your Texas License
prompt: For Texas drivers between ages 18 and 84, what is the standard validity period before a renewed license expires?

options.text: Eight years from the date of issuance on the license holder's birthday
Four years from the date of issuance on the license holder's birthday
Six years from the date of issuance on the license holder's birthday
Ten years from the date of issuance on the license holder's birthday
